arxiv-2106-03290.title: FACT: A Full-body Ad-hoc Collaboration Testbed for Modeling Complex Teamwork
arxiv-2106-03290.creator: Gopika Ajaykumar, Annie Mao, Jeremy Brown, Chien-Ming Huang, Johns Hopkins University
arxiv-2106-03290.description: Abstract Robots are envisioned to work alongside humans in applications ranging from in-home assistance to collaborative manufacturing. Research on human-robot collaboration (HRC) has helped develop various aspects of social intelligence necessary for robots to participate in effective, fluid collaborations with humans.

arxiv-2204-09745.title: ColorCode: A Bayesian Approach to Augmentative and Alternative Communication with Two Buttons
arxiv-2204-09745.creator: Matthew Daly
arxiv-2204-09745.description: Abstract Many people with severely limited muscle control can only communicate through augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) systems with a small number of buttons. In this paper, we present the design for ColorCode, which is an AAC system with two buttons that uses Bayesian inference to determine what the user wishes to communicate.

arxiv-2205-00053.title: Plasmon damping rates in Coulomb coupled 2D layers in a heterostructure
arxiv-2205-00053.creator: Dipendra Dahal 1 , Godfrey Gumbs 2 , Andrii Iurov 3 and Chin-Sen Ting 1
arxiv-2205-00053.description: Abstract The Coulomb excitations of charge density oscillation are calculated for a double layer heterostructure. Specifically, we consider two-dimensional (2D) layers of silicene and graphene on a substrate. From the obtained surface response function, we calculated the plasmon dispersion relations which demonstrate the way in which the Coulomb coupling renormalizes the plasmon frequencies.

arxiv-2210-08824.title: Protocols for Rydberg entangling gates featuring robustness against quasi-static errors
arxiv-2210-08824.creator: Charles Fromonteil, Dolev Bluvstein, Hannes Pichler
arxiv-2210-08824.description: Abstract We introduce a novel family of protocols for entangling gates for neutral atom qubits based on the Rydberg blockade mechanism. These protocols realize controlled-phase gates through a series of global laser pulses that are on resonance with the Rydberg excitation frequency.

arxiv-2211-11984.title: Impact of nonthermal electron radiation effects on the horizon scale image structure of Sagittarius A* 2022 Impact of nonthermal electron radiation effects on the horizon scale image structure of Sagittarius A* – 9
arxiv-2211-11984.creator: Shan-Shan Zhao, Lei Huang, Ru-Sen Lu, Zhiqiang Shen
arxiv-2211-11984.description: Abstract The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT), with ∼ \sim 20 μ \mu as high angular resolution, recently resolved the millimeter image of the suppermassive black hole in the Galaxy, Sagittarius A*. This opens a new window to study the plasma on horizon scales.

arxiv-2302-05841.title: Randomly Choose an Angle from an Immense Number of Angles to Rotate Qubits, Compute and Reverse For QKD Resilient Against Weak Measurements and Securing Entanglement Thanks: We would like to thank the Lynne and William Frankel Center for Computer Science, the Rita Altura Trust Chair in Computer Scie
arxiv-2302-05841.creator: Dor Bitan 1 and Shlomi Dolev 2
arxiv-2302-05841.description: Abstract This paper studies information-theoretically secure quantum homomorphic encryption (QHE) schemes of classical data. Previous works on information-theoretically secure QHE schemes (like Childs’05, Liang’13, and others) are typically based on the Quantum-One-Time-Pad (QOTP) approach of Ambainis et al. [AMTdW’00]. There, the encryption of a bit is a qubit, randomly selected from a set of four possible qubits.

arxiv-2405-02479.title: Deterministic Sub-exponential Algorithm for Discounted-sum Games with Unary Weights
arxiv-2405-02479.creator: Ali Asadi, Krishnendu Chatterjee, Raimundo Saona, Jakub Svoboda
arxiv-2405-02479.description: Abstract . Turn-based discounted-sum games are two-player zero-sum games played on finite directed graphs. The vertices of the graph are partitioned between player 1 and player 2. Plays are infinite walks on the graph where the next vertex is decided by a player that owns the current vertex.

arxiv-2406-19010.title: A numerical solution approach for non-smooth optimal control problems based on the Pontryagin maximum principle
arxiv-2406-19010.creator: Daniel Wachsmuth \authormark 1
arxiv-2406-19010.description: Abstract We consider nonsmooth optimal control problems subject to a linear elliptic partial differential equation with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions. It is well-known that local solutions satisfy the celebrated Pontryagin maximum principle. In this note, we will investigate an optimization method that is based on the maximum principle.

arxiv-2407-01968.title: Unsettled Law: Time to Generate New Approaches?
arxiv-2407-01968.creator: David Atkinson, Jacob Morrison, Correspondence: {davida, jacobm}@allenai.org
arxiv-2407-01968.description: Abstract We identify several important and unsettled legal questions with profound ethical and societal implications arising from generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), focusing on its distinguishable characteristics from traditional software and earlier AI models. Our key contribution is formally identifying the issues that are unique to GenAI so scholars, practitioners, and others can conduct more useful investigations and discussions.

arxiv-2412-03722.creator: Víctor Blanco † , Alberto Japón ‡,⋆ , Justo Puerto ‡ , and Peter Zhang ⋆ † Institute of Mathematics (IMAG), Universidad de Granada ‡ Institute of Mathematics (IMUS), Universidad de Sevilla ⋆ Heinz College of Information Systems and Public Policy, Carnegie Mellon University
arxiv-2412-03722.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Víctor Blanco † , Alberto Japón ‡,⋆ , Justo Puerto ‡ , and Peter Zhang ⋆ † Institute of Mathematics (IMAG), Universidad de Granada ‡ Institute of Mathematics (IMUS), Universidad de Sevilla ⋆ Heinz College of Information Systems and Public Policy, Carnegie Mellon University. arxiv-2508-06578.title: Refined Thermodynamic Analysis of Perfect Fluid Dark Matter Black Holes in a Phantom Background
arxiv-2508-06578.creator: Kairat Myrzakulov
arxiv-2508-06578.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kairat Myrzakulov. In this study, we examine the thermodynamics of black holes immersed in perfect fluid dark matter (PFDM) by employing the Misner-Sharp energy framework. We extend the analysis to include the thermal fluctuations of these black holes when size reduces to small size, redefining key thermodynamic variables such as pressure, volume, temperature, internal energy, and entropy within the context of PFDM.

arxiv-2508-08327.title: Synthesize, Retrieve, and Propagate: A Unified Predictive Modeling Framework for Relational Databases
arxiv-2508-08327.creator: Ning Li, Kounianhua Du, Han Zhang, Quan Gan, Minjie Wang, David Wipf, Weinan Zhang
arxiv-2508-08327.description: Abstract Relational databases (RDBs) have become the industry standard for storing massive and heterogeneous data. However, despite the widespread use of RDBs across various fields, the inherent structure of relational databases hinders their ability to benefit from flourishing deep learning methods.

arxiv-2510-05428.title: Concentrated N-dimensional AMM with Polar Coordinates in Rust
arxiv-2510-05428.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by . Current Version: October 6, 2025

Vasily Tolstikov, Marcus Wentz, Joseph Schiarizzi, Derek Ding

E–mail:

vasily@orbwap.org, marcus@orbswap.org, joseph@orbswap.org, derek@orbswap.org

SUMMARY:
We expand on the recent development of n-dimensional automated market makers for stablecoins by showing a way to build concentrated liquidity positions with ticks in polar coordinates in Rust, including the featured ability to skew said concentrated liquidity, while also highlighting the risk of stacking too many stablecoin pools and how to hedge said risk.

pmc-10738290.creator: Lillie Monroe-Lord, Azam Ardekani, Cassidy Whitman

pmc-12536616.description: White adipose tissue (WAT) browning has gained increasing attention as potential strategy for obesity management. The conversion of WAT into brown adipose tissue (BAT) enhances energy expenditure and improves metabolic health. Propolis, natural resinous substance produced by honeybees, contains bioactive compounds such as caffeic acid phenethylester, chrysin and quercetin, which are thought to regulate adipogenesis and promote WAT browning.

pmc-12995769.title: Neutrophil extracellular traps in pulmonary fibrosis: mechanisms, immunity and therapeutic targets
pmc-12995769.creator: Jing Wu, Yongbin Hu
pmc-12995769.description: Pulmonary fibrosis, a heterogeneous and fatal interstitial lung disease, lacks curative therapies and specific biomarkers, posing great clinical challenges. Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) are key inflammatory mediators in pulmonary fibrosis pathogenesis, yet subtype-specific regulatory mechanisms and targeted therapeutic optimization remain unclear. This review systematically elucidates the distinct NETosis pathways across various subtypes.
